entities.summary: Abraham "Bambol" Ng Tolentino is a Filipino politician who currently serves as the president of the Philippine Olympic Committee. He previously served as the mayor of Tagaytay from 2004 to 2013 and from 2022 to 2025, representative of Cavite's 8th district from 2019 to 2022 and the 7th district from 2013 to 2019.
